title: NYC's 1,918 Daily Noise Calls Reveal a Bigger Change
hook: NYC now gets 1,918 noise complaints every single day.
closing: The rising calls show how much city noise is wearing residents down.
question: What noise would make you call?

segments.say: Noise makes up 18% of NYC complaints. Nearly one in five reports is about what residents hear.
Noise complaints reached 700,000 in 2023. The annual total doubled, turning irritation into a citywide pattern.
NYC averages 1,918 noise calls daily. The complaint line is now busy from morning through night.
